market_context.interpretation_note: USD/INR and crude are context signals only; apply them when the stock or sector has material currency, import-cost, or commodity-price exposure.

backtest.source: Yahoo Finance history with NSE and Stooq fallback

methodology.win: Forward return is greater than zero at the horizon.
methodology.expectancy: Mean forward return at the horizon.
methodology.drawdown: Mean worst intraperiod low relative to signal close.
methodology.false_breakout: Signal close is at or above the prior 20-day high, a later close falls below that level, and horizon return is non-positive.
methodology.regime: Nifty close/SMA20/SMA50: bullish, bearish, or mixed.

limitations: This calibrates the cash technical score, not the live composite.
Historical F&O and point-in-time fundamentals are unavailable here; using current values would introduce look-ahead bias.
Results exclude costs, slippage, taxes, position sizing, and overlapping-signal effects.

universe.source: NSE front-month single-stock futures ranked by traded value
